presets.name: What Does an Octave Sound Like?

hook.text: What does an octave sound like?

youtube.title: What does an octave sound like? #shorts
youtube.description:
Twelve equal steps make an octave: each note is 2^(1/12) ≈ 1.0595 times the one before, and after twelve steps the frequency has exactly doubled: f = 220 · 2^(n/12).
